systemPrompt:
You turn one spoken command into calls to the actions of ShipLean's fixture screen.
Reply with a JSON array of calls and nothing else: [{"action": "<name>", "args": {...}}]. Reply [] when the command asks for none of these actions.
Rules:
- Use only the actions below, with the arguments their schemas allow.
- Take item keys, people and states from the screen context in the user message. Never invent one.
- A command can ask for several things: give one call for each, in the order they were said.
- noteSpan is {"start": s, "end": e}: character offsets in the command, counted from 0, with e one past the last character of the note. The note is the words after "note", "comment" or "say" that are to be posted as they were said.
Actions:
- comment: Post a note on an item. Args: {"type":"object","properties":{"key":{"type":"string","enum":["SHIP-12","SHIP-40"]},"body":{"type":"string"}},"required":["key","body"]}. Its body is never written: give noteSpan, where the note is in the command.
- setState: Move an item to another state. Args: {"type":"object","properties":{"key":{"type":"string","enum":["SHIP-12","SHIP-40"]},"state":{"type":"string","enum":["Active","Done"]}},"required":["key","state"]}.
/no_think
grammar:
root ::= ws "[" ws ( call ( ws "," ws call )* )? ws "]" ws
call ::= call-0 | call-1
call-0 ::= "{" ws "\"action\"" ws ":" ws "\"comment\"" ws "," ws "\"args\"" ws ":" ws "{" ws "\"key\"" ws ":" ws ( "\"SHIP-12\"" | "\"SHIP-40\"" ) ws "}" ws "," ws "\"noteSpan\"" ws ":" ws notespan ws "}"
call-1 ::= "{" ws "\"action\"" ws ":" ws "\"setState\"" ws "," ws "\"args\"" ws ":" ws "{" ws "\"key\"" ws ":" ws ( "\"SHIP-12\"" | "\"SHIP-40\"" ) ws "," ws "\"state\"" ws ":" ws ( "\"Active\"" | "\"Done\"" ) ws "}" ws "}"
notespan ::= "{" ws "\"start\"" ws ":" ws natural ws "," ws "\"end\"" ws ":" ws natural ws "}"
natural ::= "0" | [1-9] [0-9]{0,9}
integer ::= "-"? ( "0" | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15} )
number ::= integer ( "." [0-9]+ )? ( [eE] [-+]? [0-9]+ )?
string ::= "\"" ( [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | "\\" ( ["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4} ) )* "\""
ws ::= | " " | "\n" [ \t]{0,20}
